gen-gf-goldman-gf-inter-tight: Wide, swaggering curves like open parentheses: that is Goldman up top. Inter Tight underneath draws bent-tubing lines with short ascenders, and that wiry compactness is what makes the wide heading stand out.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-khula: Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like letters generously wide, while its lowercase stands notably tall against the capitals. Khula, in sans-serif, firmly keeps a tall, brushy midsection and open curves.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-krub: Contemporary Krub lifts the pen early so that its curves stay unfinished, and sits beneath wide, parenthesis-round Goldman. Goldman shouts wide while Krub speaks in a taller, quieter lowercase.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-kufam: Wide, round and loud, Goldman takes the top line with confidence. Kufam, in sans-serif, draws everything like a neon tube at a single width, with generously open curves in e.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-maven-pro: Wide, round and sure of itself, that is Goldman at the top. Maven Pro draws gentle, uniform strokes with a welcoming gap in the c, so the sans body lets the heading lead.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Broad, parenthesis-round letters with plenty of elbow room: that is Goldman. Mochiy Pop One holds a sans line with its big-eyed lowercase and constant strokes, while Goldman handles the commanding statement.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans: Wide, round letters that look bold from across the room: Goldman. Noto Sans, dressed in sans-serif, fills most of its letter height with lowercase and keeps its c wide open.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Goldman spreads its letters wide, rounds every curve like an open parenthesis, and lifts its lowercase tall against the capitals. Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart too.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoin: Wide, round and full of swagger, Goldman spreads its letters out with room to spare. And Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, keeping lines open.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Wide, round letters with real presence: that is Goldman up top. Across a full column of text, Noto Sans Balinese gives every curve breathing space and keeps ascenders short, so reading glides.
